summary: Retrospective annotation of Tessa’s washing task, unsafe outdoor support, considered evasion, requested cooperation, sheltered rehanging, sock recovery and peg-bag return.

ambiguities.issue: A brace and a good usable hand are explicit; injury type, diagnosis, left/right side, pain and recovery are not specified.
Skidding/slipping/sliding descriptions are linked to the same prop episode. The prop’s final support state or repair is not narrated.
Whole washing falling and becoming muddy is a risk or imagined outcome, not an actual event. Osei’s tea towels are nearby but their later relocation is not narrated.
Pretending not to notice is contemplated but not chosen. Scoped false non-noticing must not become narrator-supported unawareness or actual deception.
Osei holds a sheet corner and later the sheet under the shelter; precise corner identity and continuous sheet transport are not narrated. No extra transport/handoff is invented.
Two pegs per corner does not specify the total corners clipped or every extra edge peg. No total of eight or inventory subtraction is invented.
Filling the rest of the line is a summary/process preceding the last-sock incident; the final sock is pegged only after recovery.
Closing one tiny sock beside its pair may denote either known member. Provisional closing references are constrained to the established pair, not counted as new socks.
The peg bag is returned while blue pegs visibly remain holding the sheet. Bag contents and return of all pegs are not asserted.
Four o’clock has no stated meridiem/date. The pharmacy bag and return support a pharmacy origin, but the visit transaction and a precise closing time are unreported.

feature_gaps.resolution: Existing quantifier_binding/count fields with bound-variable corner and peg-pair referents suffice. No new field proposed.

feature_gaps.meaning: Unresolved paired-object reference without increasing object count
feature_gaps.resolution: Existing identity_hypothesis carries candidate identity and distinct-other-member constraints; the entity registry marks provisional references as not new physical objects.

prompt_feedback: Separate a negative belief inside an unchosen pretense from actual unawareness; scope and factuality must remain correlated.
A multi-predicate recollection such as the shirts and socks she had hung can refer to an explicit episode with component event IDs instead of inventing another action.
Distinguish a completed bag return from returning every tool normally stored in it, especially when the final image shows tools still in use.
Task-order came first and rain stitched are not literal locomotion or sewing. Interpret the selected sense before assigning a physical event kind.
coverage_notes: All 717 words have manually selected contextual POS and lemma choices. All 1,024 feature definitions, overrides, v3 extension registry and three frozen example bundles were read. Sparse fields preserve whole-story retrospective reference resolution with local time/scope. Shape validation is separate from semantic paragraph review.
